_meta.description: GradedFacts CH Source Registry — Swiss federal institutions, public broadcasters, and leading newspapers with independence and quality assessments.
_meta.methodology: Same tier and independence criteria as the US registry. Tier: primary = original data or official records produced by the institution; secondary = journalism citing primary sources; tertiary = aggregation or opinion. Independence: not implied by official status — assessed on documented editorial or operational independence from political direction.

schema.is_independent: true when no documented editorial control by political actors with a direct stake in outcomes
schema.affiliation_note: required when is_independent is false; explains the documented dependency

sources.name: Federal Statistical Office (BFS / OFS / UST)
sources.independence_note: Switzerland's principal federal statistical agency, established under the Federal Statistics Act (BStatG). The Act mandates that BFS produce and publish official statistics independently of political direction; results may not be withheld or altered by the Federal Council or individual departments. Hosted under the admin.ch domain but operationally distinct from departmental communications: statistical outputs are subject to peer review and methodological audit, not Federal Council editorial approval. Equivalent in independence design to national statistical offices such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics or Eurostat member offices.

sources.name: Federal Chancellery (Bundeskanzlei / Chancellerie fédérale)
sources.affiliation_note: The Federal Chancellery is the general staff of the Federal Council (Switzerland's seven-member executive). It coordinates official government communications and publishes federal legislation via the Federal Gazette (Bundesblatt). Content reflects current Federal Council positions and policy communications. Reliable as an authoritative record of official federal decisions and legislation; not independent of the executive.

sources.name: Swiss Federal Supreme Court (Bundesgericht / Tribunal fédéral)
Swiss Federal Administration (admin.ch)
sources.affiliation_note: admin.ch is the official web portal of the Swiss federal administration and serves as an umbrella domain for all federal departments and agencies. Content is produced directly by Federal Council departments and reflects current government policy. Individual agencies hosted under admin.ch — such as the Federal Statistical Office (bfs.admin.ch) and the Federal Chancellery (bk.admin.ch) — may have differing independence assessments; those are registered separately. The admin.ch root domain itself is not independent of the executive.

sources.name: FORS — Swiss Centre of Expertise in the Social Sciences
sources.independence_note: Swiss Centre of Expertise in the Social Sciences, hosted at the University of Lausanne and jointly funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) and the universities of Basel, Berne, Geneva, Lausanne, and Zurich. No commercial ownership; no documented political party funding or editorial interference. Manages Swiss Electoral Studies (Selects), the Swiss Household Panel (SHP), and other nationally representative longitudinal surveys. Widely cited in academic social science research on Switzerland.
